value.name: Daniel deflects Rosa's concern
value.description: Daniel gives a short laugh and turns toward Rosa, implying she may be mistaken about which shelf or year the folder belongs to.
evidence: out a short laugh that didn't reach anywhere near his eyes and turned his head toward Rosa, asking whether she was sure she wasn't thinking of some other shelf, some other year, his mother had kept so many folders.

value.name: Rosa stays silent
value.description: Rosa does not answer Daniel and instead keeps her hand resting on the folded towel by the mirror.
evidence: Rosa did not answer; she only let her hand rest on the folded towel by the mirror

value.name: Asha notices Daniel shifting toward Rosa
value.description: Asha observes Daniel shifting his weight toward Rosa, reading it as an attempt to discredit the person who has lived in the house longest.
evidence: Asha noted the second small movement of his, the way his weight shifted again toward Rosa instead of toward her, as if the easier person to discredit was the one who had lived in the house longest.

value.name: Asha waits on missing statement
value.description: Asha remains poised over the page where the March statement should be, while the eucalyptus smell lingers unchanged.
evidence: The eucalyptus smell had not moved, and neither had Asha's thumb on the page where the March statement should have been.

value.name: Asha asks about the blue folder
value.description: Asha asks whether the blue folder is still in the attic, speaking in a way that forces Daniel to answer directly.
evidence: "Is the blue folder still in the attic?" Asha asked, stepping past Daniel's shifted weight without looking at him, her voice flat enough that the question landed as a fact he would have to dispute rather than a query he could deflect.

value.name: Daniel tries to turn back to Rosa
value.description: Daniel begins to angle his face back toward Rosa with a strained smile, but is prevented from redirecting the exchange.
evidence: Daniel started to angle his face back toward Rosa, the strained smile already half-built, but Rosa did not give it anywhere to go

value.name: Rosa confirms the attic location
value.description: Rosa looks only at Asha and nods toward the ceiling, signaling that the blue folder is in the attic above the winter coats.
evidence: she looked only at Asha and tipped her chin once toward the ceiling, the small definite movement of a person who had carried laundry up those stairs for thirty years and knew exactly which board creaked under the shelf above the winter coats.

value.name: Asha accepts Rosa's confirmation
value.description: Asha catches Rosa's nod and holds onto it, treating it as decisive evidence.
evidence: Asha caught the nod and held it

value.name: Daniel loses control of the exchange
value.description: The interaction shifts against Daniel as he touches his neck and his authority in the house weakens.
evidence: and something in the hallway rearranged itself: Daniel's hand went back to his neck, and the second small certainty in the house was no longer his.

value.name: Asha takes the statements and moves on
value.description: Asha tucks the bank statements under her arm, preparing to act on the information she has gained.
evidence: Asha tucked the bank statements under her arm
